gold: Hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole

selector.rationale: The presence of emulsified silicone oil and hyperreflective dots within a lamellar macular hole, as shown by multimodal imaging and en face swept source OCT, strongly supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Rhegmatogenous Retinal Detachment
rejected.why: Although the patient had a history of rhegmatogenous retinal detachment, the current findings do not suggest an active detachment.

rejected.label: Silicone oil-induced retinal toxicity
rejected.why: While emulsified silicone oil is present, the primary issue appears to be the lamellar macular hole rather than toxicity.

rejected.label: Silicone oil syndrome
rejected.why: The findings are more specific to a lamellar macular hole than a broad syndrome related to silicone oil.
